name: Pinball Arcade: Space Shuttle
storyline: Space Shuttle (1984): is a classic Williams table designed by Barry Oursler and Joe Kaminkow. It features a fantastic space exploration theme and was the first Williams game to feature a playfield toy with its replica of NASAs Space Shuttle. At the time of its release, pinball revenue was way down. The commercial success of Space Shuttle allowed Williams to keep making pinball, paving the way for all of the great tables released after 1984. With its great features and out-of-this-world play action excitement, this game is a once-in-a-millennium masterpiece! 7,000 units of this table were produced.
